profile.name: DLPC900 数字微镜器件
profile.description: 基于 Texas Instruments DLPC900 控制器的数字微镜器件（DMD）图案投影系统，常见型号包括 DLP6500 和 DLP9000。该设备通过微镜阵列高速切换空间光图案，可用于实验室中的结构光照明、光学图案投射、触发同步显示以及其他需要精确时序控制的光调制实验。
profile.description_en: A digital micromirror device (DMD) pattern projection system based on the Texas Instruments DLPC900 controller, including models such as the DLP6500 and DLP9000. It uses a micromirror array to switch spatial light patterns at high speed, making it suitable for laboratory applications such as structured illumination, optical pattern projection, trigger-synchronized display, and other light modulation experiments requiring precise timing control.

registry.name: TI DLPC900 DMD
registry.description: TI DLPC900 DMD Controller是由Texas Instruments生产的表征设备，主要功能包括停止、初始化、加载、复位、执行、数据保存。支持Signal, Slot, combine patterns等操作。
